result:
The direct-Trash feature is finished, with one real safety bug fixed along the way. `cargo test` passes 42/42 (the 41 existing tests plus one new) and `cargo build --release` is current with the source. I did not render snapshots or look at the new layouts, so every visual change below is unviewed.

**Files changed:** `src/ui.rs`, `src/ui/view.rs`, `src/ui/review.rs`, `src/ui/confirm.rs`, `src/main.rs`. I did not touch `theme.rs`, `foundation.rs`, the backends, scripts, or judging, and made no commits.

**Safety fix**
- The direct path used `collector.apply(&report)`, which matches collected records by path alone. That had two consequences:
  - A refused or failed direct Trash stamped an error onto an unrelated collected record at the same path.
  - A successful direct Trash removed a collected record at that path even when its identity differed.
- I replaced it with `App::settle_single_trash`. It acts only when the outcome is `Trashed`, and removes only a record whose path, identity and ancestor chain all match the moved item.
- A refusal, failure or cancellation of the direct action leaves collected records unmarked, and they are re-checked against the fresh scan after the rescan.
- The batch path is unchanged, and the rescan still always runs after a confirmed attempt.
- A new test, `direct_trash_captures_one_item_and_never_touches_other_records`, covers:
  - capture of one item, with the collector left untouched;
  - the dialog content at 60×20, 80×24 and 140×44;
  - a wrong word never confirming, and Escape cancelling;
  - a failed or missing outcome leaving collected records unmarked;
  - a same-path impostor identity being kept;
  - an exact match being removed.

**Visual changes**
- **Footer:**
  - Below 80 columns it reads `t Trash  d delete  Space add  c review  ? help  q quit` (54 characters, fits 60 columns). It previously had no quit and a bare `?`.
  - A new 80–107 column tier adds move/open.
  - When the scan has inaccessible entries, informational messages are no longer coloured as danger.
- **Header stats line:** this was clipped at 60 columns. It now switches to a compact `files · dirs · here` form when the long form doesn't fit.
- **Detail panel:**
  - Size and percent are right-aligned to the panel edge; they used to float mid-panel.
  - The previously empty middle row shows the selected item's full path, truncated from the left so the item name stays visible.
  - The hint row reads `Enter open`, plus `t move to Trash` at 80 columns and wider.
- **Trash confirmation** (the dialog shared by the direct and collector flows):
  - The direct title is "Move this item to the system Trash?".
  - For the direct item it shows name, path, size and kind; a path too long for two lines keeps its end so the name isn't lost.
  - The "Space is freed when Trash is emptied" note is unchanged.
  - Esc and Enter are now split left and right instead of separated by padded spaces.
  - A kicker line reads `SYSTEM TRASH · recoverable until emptied`. It was written for the direct dialog, but I did not check whether it also appears in the collector confirmation.
- **Permanent-delete dialog:** it has a matching `PERMANENT DELETE · not recoverable` kicker and the same left/right split, with the delete action in the danger colour.

**Limitations**
- I never exercised a real trash operation or a PTY session.
- The inaccessible-entries footer still replaces the key hints when no message is showing. The narrow header keeps `Space collect · c review`, but `t` and `d` are not shown there.
- The collector review layout is unchanged apart from `tail` becoming `pub(super)`.
- I changed the detail panel's second hint from "Enter to look inside" to "Enter open". If a parent PTY test matches the old string, it needs the new one.
